master:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent body-only puppet plate for a mobile character called Della.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the existing headless plum-cardigan and ivory-blouse body on a square transparent canvas. Input image 2 is a reference for Della's warm natural skin tone, age, hands, fabric, and soft frontal lighting. Do not use or redraw the face from image 2.
Primary request: keep the edit target's central torso, neck opening, collar, blouse buttons, plum knit color, scale, and placement exactly unchanged. Replace the short empty sleeves with two anatomically natural complete cardigan sleeves and hands raised gently at upper chest height for a welcoming explanation gesture. The elbows can extend low, but the hands should appear around the center-to-lower third of this square, below the empty neck opening. The hand on the viewer's left is slightly more open, palm angled upward and inward; the other is softer and relaxed. Mature Black woman's hands, clear five-finger anatomy, subtle age texture, relaxed wrists. Match the original soft frontal photographic lighting. Sleeve knit and ribbed cuffs must connect naturally to both wrists, and upper sleeves must match the torso shoulder joins.
Composition: one aligned headless body only, square canvas, body continues to the bottom crop exactly as the original. Leave the entire empty head/neck opening transparent. Keep generous transparent margin around hands. No head, face, hair, earrings, background, checkerboard, captions, shadows outside the body, duplicate limbs, bracelets or extra props. This is a layered puppet source, not a whole character redesign. Preserve transparency.
viewerLeftRejected:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: isolated aligned transparent arm layer for a 2D puppet.
Input image is the edit target and alignment reference, an exactly square headless Della body plate. Produce the SAME square canvas with absolutely the same scale and pixel-relative placement.
Retain ONLY the complete sleeve and connected open hand on the VIEWER'S LEFT of the input (Della's right arm). Keep its actual photographic pose, mature skin tone, five fingers, nails, shading, wrist, ribbed cuff, plum knit texture and outer silhouette unchanged. Keep the upper sleeve from the shoulder slope around x350,y400 down to the elbow around x170,y880 and the cuff/wrist and open palm reaching inward to x550,y930. Include a rounded generous shoulder overlap cap hidden inside the torso, ending around x360,y540; the torso will cover this joint. Do not shorten the arm to just a hand.
Remove the torso, ivory blouse, central cardigan front and pocket, other arm and all other pixels to full transparency. Separate at the natural upper-arm/torso seam; no remaining central cardigan body below the sleeve. No recentering, resizing, mirroring, new pose, background, checkerboard, head, text or added shadows. One limb in its original aligned position on the original square transparent canvas.
viewerRightRejected:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: isolated aligned transparent arm layer for a 2D puppet.
Input is the square headless Della body plate, the edit target and alignment reference. Produce the SAME square canvas with the same scale and position.
Retain ONLY the entire plum-cardigan sleeve and connected relaxed open hand on the VIEWER'S RIGHT of the input (Della's left arm). Preserve the original pose, mature Black woman's skin tone, five-finger anatomy, nails, lighting, wrist, ribbed cuff, plum knit fabric, and outer silhouette. Keep the upper sleeve at its original right shoulder slope through the right elbow and cuff; keep the hand reaching inward in its current chest-level gesture. Include a generous rounded shoulder cap with about 60 pixels of overlap into the torso, for a concealed rotation joint.
Remove the ivory blouse, central cardigan torso and pockets, other arm and all remaining pixels to real transparency. Separate along the natural sleeve/torso seam. Do not retain a body flap hanging below the sleeve. No repositioning, resizing, mirroring, new pose, recentering, props, text, background or checkerboard. One complete limb in the original aligned position on the original transparent square canvas.
decision: The independent extractions visibly altered placement and scale. Preserve the master unchanged; use code-native source-coordinate clipping and rigid transforms. Generated face RGB is never used.
